c1-leakage-invariant.title: Leakage invariant on interior cutoff
c1-leakage-invariant.imperative: Read _resolve_eval_year_split + build_labeled_batches_for_module: confirm TRAIN = train_years(all rounds) + eval_year rounds <= N, EVAL = eval_year target range only, NO training event eval_year round > N. Confirm test asserts this on interior cutoff N=6/12.
c1-leakage-invariant.finding: PASS (the critical check). _resolve_eval_year_split (holdout_modes.py:48-102): default path returns (list(train_years),None,None). Cutoff path returns ([*train_years, eval_year], {eval_year:(1,N)}, {eval_year:eval_window}) with eval_window[0] > N enforced (line 94-99). build_labeled_batches_for_module applies window per-year only where keyed (orch.py:576-578): train_years get NO key -> full rounds; eval_year in train pool windowed to (1,N). EVAL built from [eval_year] with (lo,hi), lo>N. Mathematically: no training event can be eval_year round > N. Test uses INTERIOR N=6 of 12, EVAL=(7,12); test_no_training_event_from_eval_year_after_cutoff asserts leaked==[]; test_eval_year_rounds_through_cutoff_join_training asserts exactly [1..6].

Also checked race-weekend channels (UNTOUCHED by this diff): _build.py:197-213 form is strictly idx<round_idx; _memory.py:271-273 same-year memory capped to min(max_round,round_idx) (reaches at most current round R, never > R). For a training event at eval_year round R<=N, all features come from rounds <R<=N and label=R<=N. NOTHING reaches round > N.
